identity.name: Presage Sharp Dial
identity.one_liner: The 40.2mm Presage with the sharp-edged Sharaku dial pattern and the 6R35 caliber — the most-cited Seiko dress automatic at the $850 price point.

narrative.story: The SPB429 is part of Seiko's Presage Sharp Dial series, which draws on the Japanese Sharaku woodblock-print aesthetic — the dial pattern is a series of radiating sharp-edged lines. The 6R35 caliber (hand-wind, hacking, 70-hour reserve) is Seiko's mid-range automatic. The 40.2mm stainless steel case, sapphire crystal, and see-through caseback are the modern Presage specification. The SPB429 is the most-cited Presage dress watch at the $850 price point.
narrative.collector_notes: The 6R35 replaced the 6R15 with a longer reserve (70h vs 50h). The Sharaku pattern references Toshusai Sharaku, an 18th-century ukiyo-e artist.
